reason: I already keep diaries and file ΟΣΔΕ for 200 growers with the ΚΥΔ software and my own spreadsheets, and the δάκος warnings come from the ΔΑΟΚ traps and from me. This looks built for one grower with his own trees, not for someone managing a whole client list, and nothing says it covers the eco-scheme records that actually get paid.
objection: Is the 'ready for ΟΣΔΕ' diary actually accepted by ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ for the eco-schemes, and can I trust a one-person developer with my clients' parcel and cost data, in the middle of filing season, if he disappears next year?
would_change_my_mind: A consultant mode where I manage all my growers under one account and export diaries in exactly the format the eco-schemes and ΟΣΔΕ checks require, shown to me by another ΚΥΔ that already uses it.
